name: Wildfires
summary: No GDACS orange or red wildfire alerts
state: GDACS listed no orange or red wildfire alerts on 4 Nov, with 81 green-level fire events worldwide. No fires were reported forcing mass evacuations from populated areas.
for_you: No action needed; follow local fire service advice where you are.
why: Large fires destroy towns, cause hazardous smoke over continents and drive insurance losses.
drivers: Drought, heat, wind, fuel load, ignition, season.

rubric.alert: Fires burning into populated areas with fatalities or mass evacuation, or GDACS red.
rubric.watch: Large fires forcing evacuations, or GDACS orange.
rubric.normal: No GDACS orange/red wildfire alerts and no major evacuations.
